description: Superfund: Retrieve a site by exact SEMS site ID from epa_superfund_search_sites or by EPA ID, the SEMS program ID epa_echo_get_case lists, with all recorded contaminant associations and their media, operable units, and EPA actions. Repeated chemicals in different contexts and duplicate source rows are retained. An existing site without contaminant records returns an empty array. Associations do not establish current exposure, concentrations, or current risk. Site and contaminant requests share a 50-second deadline.

site_id.description: SEMS siteId from epa_superfund_search_sites (7 digits; preserve leading zeros), or the site's EPA ID (2 letters and 10 letters or digits, any case)

name: epa_superfund_get_site

contaminants.description: Every SEMS contaminant association for the site

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `site_not_found`: No SEMS site has this site ID or EPA ID. `unmatchable_filter`: site_id holds a character DMAP cannot match exactly. `filter_too_long`: site_id makes the request too long. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nonNplStatusName.description: Non-NPL assessment label; not cleanup progress

nplStatus.description: F final, A part of an NPL site, N not listed, P proposed, D deleted, R removed, W withdrawn

title: Get Superfund Site
